prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though select tests like sign_in redesign (round 6) and home notification (round 4) were underpredicted.
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 4 tests.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful in 1 winning test, though 3 other tests showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen changes showed no clear effect or hurt performance across 2 tests.
Adoption layout changes (3 tests) and choose_path redesign changes (2 tests) yielded no clear effect or hurt performance.
Evidence remains thin for choose_path copy, finish layout, finish copy, finish redesign, home notification, sign_in redesign, adoption redesign, and adoption new_screen changes (fewer than 2 agreeing tests).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: -0.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -6.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

- choose_path, copy: -2.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Layout Photo Upload Redesign: Redesign the custom photo upload screen using a spotlight layout to highlight clear photo guidelines and companion customizer previews. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion) and support received 3 emails about custom photo creation failing or rendering incorrectly.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet First Launch New Screen: Add a dedicated completion screen explaining where to find the pet icon in the system tray and how to open companion controls. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding pet controls and pet visibility after completing setup (3 emails for missing pets, 3 emails for controls).)
2: [sign_in, hint] Multi Device Pet Sync Account Hint: Add an explicit safeguard hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging into the same account keeps existing pets intact across reinstallations. (why: Support received 8 emails (the largest complaint category) about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Seamless Cloud Pet Save Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize automatic cloud protection for pet data and progress. (why: 8 support emails were caused by account reset confusion when re-signing in.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Display Readiness Sound Notification: Enable desktop notification readiness with an audio cue component when waiting companion rendering finishes. (why: Long wait times (mean 2,336s) cause users to minimize the app, missing when the pet is ready on the desktop.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Two Column Path Selection Screen: Change the layout of the choose path screen to a two-column structure for clearer visual comparison between companion paths. (why: Choose path conversion is 76.2% with long mean completion times (514s), suggesting visual clarity could improve decision speed.)
6: [finish, redesign] Split Layout Home Welcome Overview: Redesign the home introduction welcome view into a split layout separating desktop interaction instructions from feature highlights. (why: Finish conversion drops to 68.0% and support emails show post-onboarding confusion around controlling and managing pets on desktop.)
